title: OpenVINO tokenizers wheel build fails - openvino~=2026.5.0.dev not yet available on pip

failed_jobs.name: OpenVINO tokenizers extension / OpenVINO tokenizers extension
failed_jobs.symptom: pip cannot satisfy openvino~=2026.5.0.dev build dependency - package not yet published

key_errors: ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement openvino~=2026.5.0.dev (from versions: ..., 2026.4.0.dev20260827)
ERROR: No matching distribution found for openvino~=2026.5.0.dev

root_cause: The openvino_tokenizers build system (pyproject.toml) specifies openvino~=2026.5.0.dev as a required build dependency. However, the latest available version on PyPI as of this run is 2026.4.0.dev20260827 - the 2026.5 dev release has not been published yet. This prevents pip from satisfying the build dependency, causing the tokenizers wheel build to fail. This is a pre-existing infrastructure/versioning issue unrelated to PR #37686 (which only modifies a C API test file). The fix requires either: (1) waiting for the 2026.5.0.dev nightly to be published, or (2) relaxing the version constraint in pyproject.toml.
reproduction_steps: N/A - CI-environment specific; reproducible by running: pip install openvino~=2026.5.0.dev
recommended_actions: Check if openvino_tokenizers/pyproject.toml has been updated to require openvino~=2026.5.0.dev prematurely
Relax the version pin or revert the pyproject.toml version constraint to match the latest available nightly
Alternatively wait for the 2026.5.0.dev nightly build to be published to PyPI
Re-queue PR #37686 once the openvino nightly is published or the constraint is fixed
prevention_strategies: Before bumping the required openvino version in pyproject.toml, verify the new nightly version is already available on PyPI. Add a CI pre-check that validates required dependencies are resolvable before starting the build.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of this specific version constraint failure. Dependency resolution failures against PyPI nightly packages are a known risk when version numbers are bumped ahead of publication.
